searchText: Curious to know if you have checked the performances against the Rust implementation that is inside leanVM? just did on the same machine - verify: rust 81µs, go 127µs sign: rust 78ms, go 190ms key_gen: rust 42ms, go 66ms the verify gap is basically all keccak-f, geth has keccak asm on amd64 only, so i would expect Go to be a lot closer there, havent got an amd64 box on hand to check tho the sign gap is on my implementation, i hash the top tree twice (once for the root and once for the auth path), can cache it

excerpts.content: Curious to know if you have checked the performances against the Rust implementation that is inside leanVM?

excerpts.author: vansh_sahay
excerpts.content:
just did on the same machine - 
verify: rust 81µs, go 127µs
sign: rust 78ms, go 190ms
key_gen: rust 42ms, go 66ms

the verify gap is basically all keccak-f, geth has keccak asm on amd64 only, so i would expect Go to be a lot closer there, havent got an amd64 box on hand to check tho

the sign gap is on my implementation, i hash the top tree twice (once for the root and once for the auth path), can cache it
